final.memo:
Since our initial engagement, the Company has moved from a sluggish incumbent to an entity demonstrably responding to our core asks. Management has committed to a medium-term margin objective of 17.5–18.5% and has launched a significant CHF20 billion buyback program, directly addressing our concerns regarding capital efficiency [D03].

While organic growth of 2.4% remains below our initial expectations, the company is showing progress in margin expansion through cost savings despite inflationary pressures [D02; D03]. We view the 'NestléNOW' presentation released today as a crucial catalyst that makes our case for structural transformation and focus visible to the broader market [D01; D04].

We remain disciplined in our view that operational turnaround is a process, not a single event. With the leadership of CEO Schneider and chairman Paul Bulcke now firmly aligned with a plan to simplify the portfolio and drive higher returns, we are increasing our conviction in the path toward 20-30% IRR potential as execution matures [D03; D07]. We are adding to our position to benefit from the ongoing re-rating as these structural changes take hold [D07].
